_about: Hit zone slot NAMES, dictated by Raven on review -- one monster at a time, reading each row's capsules on the render (a row's name draws its rBodyData shapes, see pickZone in index.html). The ROM ships no zone-name table, so a person saying what a slot is is the only source there is. Keyed by monster id, then by damage-table slot (the row index hitzones.json's tables and capsules use). These are the only slot names the chart shows (since 2026-09-16 hitzones.json's community names are not shown); a slot not named here reads Slot N. `reviewed` is the date the names were given.

em001_00.note: Raven: "Rathian, same as Gold but without the final slot". Slots 0-6 sit on the same joints as Gold Rathian's; Rathian keeps the tail's last capsule (joint 144) in its Tail row, where Gold splits it off as Tail Tip.

em001_04.note: Raven: "Dreadqueen is the same as Gold". Same eight slots on the same joints as em001_02 (slot 5 carries two more wing spheres, on joints 8 and 12).

em002_00.note: Raven: "Rathalos Line: Head, Neck, Back, Belly, Tail, Wings, Legs, Tail Tip (Silver/Dread)". Rathalos takes the first seven. Same slots on the same joints as Rathian; Tail (slot 4) keeps the tail's last capsule (joint 144), as Rathian's does.

em002_02.note: Raven: "Rathalos Line: Head, Neck, Back, Belly, Tail, Wings, Legs, Tail Tip (Silver/Dread)". Same eight slots on the same joints as Gold Rathian: Tail Tip (slot 7) is the capsule on joint 144, and the sphere on that joint stays in Tail (slot 4).

em002_04.note: Raven: "Rathalos Line: Head, Neck, Back, Belly, Tail, Wings, Legs, Tail Tip (Silver/Dread)". Same slots as Silver Rathalos except at the tail end: Tail Tip (slot 7) takes both the sphere and the capsule on joint 144, where Silver Rathalos and Dreadqueen Rathian keep that sphere in Tail (slot 4). Slot 5 carries two more wing spheres (joints 8 and 12), as on Dreadqueen.

em004_00.note: Named from the render. Same skeleton as Gravios, but laid out like the Rathian line: neck (1), tail (4) and tail end (7, on joint 143) each have a slot, and one slot holds both wings (5) and one both legs (6).

em005_00.note: Named from the render. Same skeleton as Basarios, laid out differently: slot 1 holds both the neck and the tail capsules, and wings and legs take a slot per side (4 and 6 on the higher-x side).

em007_00.note: Named from the render. Wings/Back (slot 2) is the back with the wing arms (joints 7-9 and 11-13); Wing Flaps (slot 4) is the two membrane capsules (8-60 and 12-70); Tail Tip (slot 7) is the two capsules on joint 145. Head (slot 0) holds the two horn capsules, the head sphere and a sphere on joint 103; Bloodbath Diablos keeps only its horns in slot 0 and files those two spheres under slot 1.

em007_04.note: Named from the render. Horns (slot 0) is its six horn capsules on joint 3; Head (slot 1) holds the head spheres, the spheres on joint 103 and the sphere on joint 101, which Diablos splits between Head and Neck. Wings (slot 2) has the same shapes as Diablos' Wings/Back (the back sphere and capsule with the wing arms). Several shapes are listed twice, the second copy larger (head, joint 103, belly, tail).

em032_00.note: Named from the render. Belly (slot 2) and Back (slot 3) share joints 1 and 140, Belly below the spine and Back above it. Wings (slot 5) is the forelimbs from the shoulders (joints 6 and 10) to the spheres at their ends (joints 40 and 50).

em032_04.note: Named from the render. Back (slot 1) holds what Tigrex splits over Neck (the spheres on joints 100-102) and Back, plus the shoulder spheres (joints 6 and 10) that Tigrex keeps in Wings. The claws are one sphere each at the end of a foreleg, radius 90 where Tigrex's are 65 inside Wings: Left Claw (slot 3) on joint 40, the higher-x side as on Gravios, and Right Claw (slot 7) on joint 50. Wings (slot 5) is Tigrex's Wings without the shoulder and claw spheres.

em033_00.note: Named from the render. Belly (slot 2) is the body core on joints 1, 100 and 140; Back (slot 3) sits above it, reaching joints 151 and 152 high on the back, and Neck (slot 1) also takes a shape on joint 151. The slot order is not Ukanlos': Tail, Arms and Legs are slots 4-6 here, 6, 3 and 4 there.

em037_00.note: Named from the render; the same names as Silverwind Nargacuga, whose slots sit on the same joints except one shape: the sphere on joint 5 (record 15, on the arm) is in Wings (slot 4) here and in Tail (slot 6) on Silverwind.

em037_04.note: Named from the render. Raven asked to verify slot 6: "it seems off to have a sphere on the arm like that for a tail region". Verified from the raw .bdd (build/frag copy byte-identical to the extracted ROM file): record 15, a sphere on joint 5 (radius 95 at 100, 0, 20), carries damage row 6 here and row 4 on Nargacuga. Its mirror on the other arm, record 21 on joint 9 (radius 95 at -100, 0, 20), is row 4 on both. Both spheres keep part record 4, the arm capsules' part, and the u16 at +10 is 512 on both, so the one-sided change is the only difference. Silverwind also enlarges two tail capsules (records 13 and 14).

em042_00.note: Named from the render. Back (slot 1) runs above the body from the neck (joints 100-102) to joint 140, Belly (slot 2) below it. Wing Blades (slot 3) is two shapes at the far ends of the forelimbs (joints 8-9 and 14-15); Wings (slot 4) the rest of the forelimbs.

em077_00.note: Named from the render, the full eight in slot order (an earlier seven-name list was not applied).

em043_00.note: Named from the render, then given Savage Deviljho's terms (Raven: "Apply Savage's terms to Deviljho"; same joints and slots): Belly is slot 1's single sphere under the front of the body (joint 2), Back the spine capsules. First named Chest and Torso.

em043_05.note: Named from the render, handed to the render agent directly (Savage is otherwise another agent's test case; this file is read only by the hit-zone chart). Same joints and slots as Deviljho, which now carries these same terms.

em044_00.note: Named from the render. Right Leg (slot 3) is the lower-x side and Left Leg (slot 4) the higher-x side, the same sides as Gravios' Left/Right with the slot order flipped.

em045_04.note: Raven: "Crystalbeard is the same as Uragaan". Same joints and slots as em045_00, no differences.

em055_00.note: Named from the render. Slots 0 (Head) and 1 (Horns) both hang off joint 3, told apart on the render.

em063_00.note: Named from the render ("Brachy"). Horn (slot 0) and Head (slot 1) both hang off joint 3; Pounders are the arms down to the fists.

em063_05.note: Raven: "Raging is the same as Brachy". Same seven slots as em063_00, none swapped. Pounders (slot 3) also takes joints 40 and 50, reaching the hands, and Tail (slot 5) has a capsule on joint 143 instead of 142.

em081_00.unsure: Raven, 2026-09-15: "I am not confident with Astalos hit zone table or capsule slots", "their hit zone values normally reflect each other". Measured over the library: 14 slot pairs have capsules that mirror left/right (11 exactly, 3 near), and 13 of them have identical rows in table 1. Astalos' wings (slots 3/7) are the one exception, and their capsules are only a near mirror: 5 of 7 match, while the two wing-membrane capsules (records 14 on joint 60 and 19 on joint 70) differ in shape. The only other asymmetric pair is Stonefist Hermitaur slots 3/7 (table 0, Thunder 15/20). Held for the review pass.
em081_00.note: Named from the render. Left Wing (slot 3) is the higher-x side, as on Gravios; Pincers (slot 6) is the tail end on joint 138. Raven, on the wings: "One wing is a 25 Ice zone, normally wings are symetrical". Verified from the raw em081_00_dttune.dtt (tables at 0x8e, every row ending in its stun/exhaust pair, the community parse agreeing): table 0 gives both wings 25/25/20 5/5/5; table 1 gives Left Wing 25/25/25 6/10/15 and Right Wing 55/55/45 10/20/25. Table 1 also puts Stun 100 on slot 1 (Body), and its slots 6-7 equal Boltreaver's table 1 slots 6-7 exactly. What selects table 1 in the game is not established.

em081_04.note: Named from the render. Same slots on the same joints as Astalos except the wings: slot 3 carries both (Astalos keeps the second wing in slot 7), and there is no slot 7.

em008_00.note: Named from the render. Back (slot 2) and Belly (slot 3) share joints 2 and 140, Back above the body and reaching up to joint 100, Belly below.

em009_00.note: Named from the render. Neck (slot 1) is one capsule under the head, from joint 100 to the head (joint 3); Belly (slot 3) is one sphere low under the body on joint 0. Head (slot 0) also takes the shapes on joint 150 above it. The layout does not follow Yian Kut-Ku's.

em014_00.note: Named from the render. Head (slot 0) is the shapes on joints 101 and 103 and the capsule spanning 10-13, plus a sphere on bone 255 that the viewer does not place; Body (slot 1) is the other eight. Gendrome, Iodrome and Giadrome carry identical capsule rows (only their damage values differ).

em015_00.note: Raven: "Gendrome, Iodrome, and Giadrome are the same as Velocidrome". Its capsule rows are identical to Velocidrome's (only the damage values differ).

em016_00.note: Raven: "Gendrome, Iodrome, and Giadrome are the same as Velocidrome". Its capsule rows are identical to Velocidrome's (only the damage values differ).

em018_00.note: Named from the render. Back (slot 2) runs along the top of the neck, body and tail, where Neck (slot 1), Belly (slot 3) and Tail (slot 4) hold the lower sides; it also has one sphere on each lower leg (joints 17 and 21, records 27-28), a little in front of Legs' spheres. Deadeye Yian Garuga carries identical capsule rows.

em018_04.note: Raven: "Deadeye is the same" (as Yian Garuga). Its capsule rows are identical to Yian Garuga's.

em034_00.note: Raven: "Gendrome, Iodrome, and Giadrome are the same as Velocidrome". Its capsule rows are identical to Velocidrome's (only the damage values differ).

em079_00.note: Named from the render. Wing Claws (slot 3) is two one-joint capsules at the far ends of the wings (joints 132 and 133), past Wings (slot 2). Tail (slot 5) is one capsule (joints 140-141); Nightcloak Malfestio's is shorter and has four more capsules fanning out from joint 141.

em079_04.note: Raven: "Nightcloak is the same" (as Malfestio). Same slots on the same joints; only Tail (slot 5) differs: its capsule on joints 140-141 is shorter (end at -70 against -100), and four more one-joint capsules on joint 141 fan out, two to each side.

em085_00.note: Named from the render. Head (slot 0) also takes the shapes on joint 202 above it; Body (slot 1) covers the body and limbs; Tail (slot 2) is five shapes along the tail (joints 140-144).

em057_00.note: Named from the render (Raven: "Head, but I also see capsules in the body, look into this"; slot 2 first given as Belly, then "Update Belly to Back/Belly"). The body shapes in Head are records 24 (capsule on joints 140-141, r100, under the tail base) and 25 (sphere on joint 0, r180, under the belly), and they are the only two with flag word 0x0100. The hit test 0x16bc54 never counts them for any attack type: types 8/69, 9 and 37-47 test only the low byte (0x03, 0x18, 0x04), which is 0 here, and every other type skips a flag with any of 0x0152. What reads them instead is not found (a scan for tests of bit 8 on +0xa/+0xb found none). Limbs (slot 5) is the upper legs, fore and hind (joints 7, 11, 15, 19); Claws (slot 3) the forearms to the paws; Legs (slot 4) the lower hind legs.

em057_04.note: Raven: "Thunderlord is the same as Zino". Same slots on the same joints as Zinogre; the only differing row is the second head capsule (record 1, joint 3), which ends at (0, 92, 66) against Zinogre's (0, 52, 100), pointing further up. It carries the same two never-counted body shapes under Head (records 24-25, flag 0x0100; see Zinogre's note).

em022_00.note: Named from the render. Body (slot 3) is two shapes on the body core (joints 1, 2 and 100); Arms (slot 1) and Legs (slot 2) take both sides each.

em023_00.note: Named from the render; the same names, in the same order, as Blangonga's. Furious Rajang's slots sit on the same joints.

em023_05.note: Raven: "Furious is the same" (as Rajang). Same slots on the same joints as Rajang.
